title: chenopodium ambrosioides f. genuinum
intro: Chenopodium ambrosioides f. genuinum, commonly known as Mexican tea or epazote, is a plant species within the Chenopodium genus, characterized by its small, white flowers and greenish-yellow foliage. Mexican tea is known for its health benefits, including the treatment of digestive issues, such as nausea, diarrhea, and flatulence, as well as its antiparasitic properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve spasms, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Mexican tea include alkaloids, such as ascaridole and chenopodine, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
